description: This file defines API routes for managing product reviews in an e-commerce application, including adding, fetching, updating, approving, rejecting, and deleting reviews.

methods.name: POST /add
methods.description: Adds a new review, associating it with the authenticated user.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of all reviews.

methods.name: GET /:slug
methods.description: Fetches approved reviews for a product identified by its slug.

methods.name: PUT /:id
methods.description: Updates a review by its ID.

methods.name: PUT /approve/:reviewId
methods.description: Approves a review, setting its status to approved and activating it.

methods.name: PUT /reject/:reviewId
methods.description: Rejects a review by setting its status to rejected.

methods.name: DELETE /delete/:id
methods.description: Deletes a review by its ID.
